issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Switch
products.tagline: Bring any AI agent into Slack, Teams & Discord
products.summaryZh: 将任何AI代理接入Slack、Teams和Discord。
products.descriptionZh: Switch将AI代理引入你的团队已在使用的协作工具中。代理以具名参与者的身份加入你的Slack、Teams、Discord或Telegram频道，与团队共享相同的上下文和历史记录。一次连接代理，即可跨项目使用。每个房间拥有自己的上下文、参与者和规则。兼容Claude Code、OpenAI、Google ADK、LangChain等。开源、可自托管，几分钟内即可运行。
products.description: Switch brings AI agents into the collaboration tools your team already uses. Agents join as named participants in your Slack, Teams, Discord, or Telegram channels, sharing the same context and history as your team. Connect an agent once and use it across projects. Each room carries its own context, participants, and rules. Works with Claude Code, OpenAI, Google ADK, LangChain, and more. Open source, self-hostable, running in minutes.

products.name: Kombai Gallery
products.tagline: 20,000+ curated UI designs for agents and humans
products.summaryZh: 为智能体与人类精选的20,000+ UI设计资源
products.descriptionZh: 通过赋予你的智能体设计品味，打造出众的用户界面。浏览精选的网页与移动端设计，从完整页面到独立组件一应俱全。实时预览，并复制现成可用的提示词。该图库永久免费，无需注册。
products.description: Build standout UIs by giving your agent design taste. Browse curated web and mobile designs, from full pages to individual components. Preview them live and copy a ready-to-use prompt. The gallery is free forever, with no sign-up required.

products.name: OpenMarket
products.tagline: Multi-agent marketplace where proof decides who wins
products.summaryZh: 多智能体市场中，证明决定谁胜出。
products.descriptionZh: 如果市场奖励的是最好的产品，而不是最好的营销，会怎样？OpenMarket（研究预览版）是一个多智能体市场，卖家在此推销产品，竞争对手质疑其说法，独立的真相智能体在争夺买家交易时验证证据。在这里，说法不会仅仅因为写在产品页面上就成立，它们必须经得起审视并被证实。
products.description: What if marketplaces rewarded the best product instead of the best marketing? OpenMarket (in research preview), is a multi-agent marketplace where sellers pitch, competitors challenge their claims, and independent truth agents verify the evidence as they compete to earn a buyer's sale. Here, claims don’t count just because they’re written on a product page. They have to survive scrutiny and be proven.

products.name: Knockin'
products.tagline: Turns your static bio into an AI business card that replies
products.summaryZh: 将你的静态简介转化为可回复的AI名片。
products.descriptionZh: Knockin将你的个人简介转化为可对话的AI名片。添加你的工作、链接和内容。它能学习你的职业背景，并以你的口吻回答问题。访客可以立即预约你的时间，即使你不在场。Knockin会记录访客信息，让你知道该跟进谁。这减少了来回沟通，为通话双方提供更多背景信息。
products.description: Knockin turns your bio into an AI business card people can chat with. Add your work, links, and content. It learns what you do and answers questions in your voice. Visitors can book time with you right away, even when you’re away. Knockin remembers who stopped by, so you know who to follow up with. This cuts down on back and forth and gives both sides more context before a call.

products.name: Relaticle
products.tagline: Open-source CRM with approval-gated AI writes
products.summaryZh: 开源CRM，配备审批门控AI写作功能
products.descriptionZh: 大多数CRM是把AI硬加上去的。Relaticle则从代理优先出发：任何MCP客户端都能通过OAuth获得37个第一方工具，且每个代理的架构中自动包含工作区自定义字段。应用内助手更为严格：每次写入都作为提案展示具体变更，逐条记录审批。在AGPL许可下可完全自托管，包括使用Ollama进行本地推理。自托管永久免费；云端按工作区统一收费，而非按席位计费。
products.description: Most CRMs bolt AI on. Relaticle is built agent-first: any MCP client gets 37 first-party tools over OAuth, with workspace custom fields in each agent's schema automatically. The in-app assistant is stricter: every write is a proposal showing the exact change, approved record by record. Self-host everything under AGPL, including local inference with Ollama. Free forever self-hosted; Cloud is flat per-workspace pricing, not per-seat.

products.name: GoodLads
products.tagline: AI growth manager for your Google Ads account
products.summaryZh: Google Ads账户的AI增长经理
products.descriptionZh: Google Ads账户的AI增长经理。GoodLads生成假设以提升您的ROAS或CPA，一键部署每项假设——未经您批准绝不执行——并在看板板上跟踪至得出结论。
products.description: AI growth manager for Google Ads accounts. GoodLads generates hypotheses to improve your ROAS or CPA, ships each one in one click - never without your approval - and tracks it on a kanban board to a verdict.

products.name: Dictantor
products.tagline: Record meetings and transcribe privately on Apple devices
products.summaryZh: 在Apple设备上录制会议并进行私密转写
products.descriptionZh: Dictantor可在Mac、iPhone和Apple Watch上捕捉会议和语音备忘录。在Mac上，它能同时录制麦克风和系统音频，并在会议前提醒你。转录在设备端进行，支持25种欧洲语言，能将你的声音与他人区分开来。搜索功能可带你回到精确的语音时刻。无需Dictantor账户或订阅。支持的录音可通过你的私人iCloud账户同步。
products.description: Dictantor captures meetings and voice notes across Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch. On Mac, it records microphone and system audio together and prompts you before meetings. Transcription runs on device in 25 European languages, separating your voice from everyone else. Search returns you to exact spoken moments. No Dictantor account or subscription. Supported recordings can sync through your private iCloud account.

products.name: Jupitrr Cut
products.tagline: Open source app for recording vids with a teleprompter
products.summaryZh: 用于提词器录制的开源应用
products.descriptionZh: Jupitrr Cut是一款开源移动应用，用于录制精良的讲话视频。利用内置提词器逐行阅读，可随时重拍，并自动去除静音。无需接触时间线即可导出成品视频。录制视频，跳过剪辑。之后可使用Jupitrr AI添加字幕和B-roll素材——完全可选。无需注册账户。采用GPL-3.0许可证，APK文件在GitHub上提供，并可通过App Store和Google Play一键更新。
products.description: Jupitrr Cut is an open-source mobile app for recording polished talking-head videos. Use the built-in teleprompter to read line by line, retake anything, and automatically remove silences. Export a finished video without touching a timeline. Record the video. Skip the edit. Add captions and B-roll later with Jupitrr AI—completely optional. No account wall. GPL-3.0 licensed, with the APK on GitHub and one-tap updates through the App Store and Google Play.

products.name: Tables.so
products.tagline: AI that finds, qualifies and enriches your next customer
products.summaryZh: 发现、筛选并丰富您下一位客户的AI
products.descriptionZh: 寻找新客户耗时过长，且大部分时间都花在无人愿意做的工作上。因此，我们打造了Tables。您只需用日常语言描述您要找的目标，Tables便会遍历超过3亿个已验证联系人，逐一审视并回答您真正关心的问题。您将获得一份带评分的列表，包含电子邮件、电话号码及每项答案背后的来源，便于核查。它可与HubSpot、Pipedrive和Attio同步，并支持在LinkedIn及Claude内使用。
products.description: Finding new customers takes way too long and most of that time goes into work nobody wants to do. So we built Tables. You write who you are looking for in normal language and Tables goes through 300M+ verified contacts, looks into each one and answers the questions you actually care about. You get a scored list with emails, phone numbers and the sources behind every answer, so you can check it. Syncs with HubSpot, Pipedrive and Attio, and works on LinkedIn and inside Claude.

products.name: Replay QA Security Scan
products.tagline: Automated Penetration Testing  for AI-Built Apps
products.summaryZh: AI构建应用的自动化渗透测试
products.descriptionZh: Replay现在在每次QA通过时都会对你的Web应用进行渗透测试：注入漏洞、失效的访问控制、IDOR，以及AI生成代码容易遗漏的问题。测试结果以完整的漏洞报告形式返回，包含证据和建议修复方案。你可以按日或按周安排测试，省去“记得测试”这一步。醒来时，你会看到一列已经分类好的漏洞队列。同一项目还能针对开发、预发布、生产及本地环境进行测试，因此无需为每个环境维护单独的QA配置。
products.description: Replay pentests your web app on every QA pass now: injection flaws, broken access control, IDOR, the stuff AI-generated code tends to miss. Findings come back as full bug reports, evidence and suggested fix included. Schedule it daily or weekly and skip the "remember to test" step. You wake up to a queue of bugs already triaged. Same projects also test against dev, staging, prod, and localhost, so you're not maintaining separate QA setups per environment.

products.name: Kopai
products.tagline: The Cloud for AI Agents
products.summaryZh: 面向AI代理的云
products.descriptionZh: Kopai是面向AI代理的云平台。构建代理，我们负责运行。将任何代理发布为API（原生或兼容OpenAI，支持流式传输），在市场中列出，或从您自己的产品中调用。分析功能分别统计代理运行成本与收益。一条命令即可在发布前将代理与参考代理进行基准测试。认证会过期，答案会重新核查。聊天与API使用同一引擎，因此导出的代理行为与您测试时一致。
products.description: Kopai is the cloud for AI agents. Build the agent; we run it. Publish any agent as an API (native or OpenAI-compatible, with streaming), list it in the marketplace, or call it from your own product. Analytics count what an agent costs to run separately from what it earns. A one-command benchmark runs it against reference agents before you ship. Certification expires, and answers get re-checked. Chat and the API use the same engine, so an exported agent behaves like the one you tested.

products.name: Nametag
products.tagline: Your social memory to never forget a name and person again
products.summaryZh: 你的社交记忆，从此不再忘记名字与人。
products.descriptionZh: 人们喜欢你能记住他们的名字。Nametag AI是一款简单的应用，帮助你记住遇到的人的名字。通过使用位置信息，Nametag会记住你在哪里遇见某人，这样下次你到访时，可以在进门之前复习你的闪卡速记卡组。要保存某人，只需轻点并说话：“杰克，高个子，戴眼镜留胡子，喜欢烹饪，认识简。”Nametag AI会捕捉语音，并自动将信息分类为描述特征、共同联系和趣闻轶事。
products.description: People love you when you remember their name. Nametag AI is a simple app that helps you remember names of people you meet. By using location, Nametag remembers where you met a person so that the next time you visit you can review your flashcard cram deck before walking in. To save someone, simply tap and speak. "Jake, tall, mustache glasses, loves cooking, knows Jane." Nametag AI takes the voice capture and categorizes the information automatically into descriptors, mutuals, & fun facts.

products.name: SODAX SDK
products.tagline: Digital asset flows you can build and deploy with AI.
products.summaryZh: 用AI构建和部署的数字资产流。
products.descriptionZh: SODAX提供高度可定制的执行系统，用于构建稳定币、加密货币和现实世界资产交易。专注于产品和用户体验，无需承担管理区块链技术接口的技术债务。新型银行、交易所、借贷和收益协议集成SODAX SDK，以更快地交付我们在交易、借贷和收益方面的全部功能，并扩展其在区块链网络上的运营范围。SODAX是现代货币的基础设施。
products.description: SODAX provides a highly customizable execution system to build stablecoin, crypto and real world asset transactions. Focus on your product and user experience without the technical debt of managing the interface with blockchain technology. Neobanks, exchanges, lending and yield protocols integrate the SODAX SDK to ship our full range of features, across transaction, lending and yield, faster and extend their operational reach across blockchain networks. SODAX is infrastructure for modern money.

products.name: Lyrimuse
products.tagline: Word-synced macOS lyrics that pick the right version
products.summaryZh: 与单词同步的macOS歌词，自动匹配正确版本
products.descriptionZh: 为Apple Music、Spotify、QQ音乐、网易云、酷狗以及浏览器中的YouTube Music或Spotify Web提供歌词逐字同步的桌面显示。同时查询九个歌词源，每个候选按统一标准评分——标题、艺术家、专辑、时长匹配、逐字时间轴——因此现场版本、粤语版和电台剪辑都能获得真正匹配的歌词。显示形式包括浮动覆盖层、灵动岛胶囊、Apple Music风格窗口或菜单栏。免费开源，无需账户。
products.description: Word-synced desktop lyrics for Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase, Kugou, and for YouTube Music or Spotify Web in a browser. Nine lyric providers are queried at once and every candidate is scored on one scale — title, artist, album, duration fit, word-level timing — so live takes, Cantonese versions and radio edits get the words that actually match. Shows up as a floating overlay, a Dynamic Island capsule, an Apple-Music-style window, or in the menu bar. Free and open source, no account.

products.name: Coherence X6 for macOS
products.tagline: Turn websites into Mac apps powered by your browser
products.summaryZh: 将网站转化为由浏览器驱动的Mac应用
products.descriptionZh: Coherence X6将网站转化为独立、可定制的Mac应用，由Chrome及其他Chromium浏览器驱动。携带你的配置文件、登录信息、书签和扩展程序，然后控制每个应用的外观、打开方式及链接路由。
products.description: Coherence X6 turns websites into isolated, customizable Mac apps powered by Chrome and other Chromium browsers. Bring your profiles, logins, bookmarks, and extensions, then control how each app looks, opens, and routes links.

products.name: AppGacha
products.tagline: Turn a sentence into a tiny desktop app
products.summaryZh: 将一句话变成一个小型桌面应用
products.descriptionZh: AppGacha将一句普通语言的心愿转化为真正的桌面应用——实用工具、小组件、游戏及个人工具。应用在本地运行，保持便携性，并可整理到您自己的桌面工作区中。
products.description: AppGacha turns a plain-language wish into a real desktop app—utilities, widgets, games, and personal tools. Apps run locally, stay portable, and can be organized into your own desktop workspace.

products.name: bonds
products.tagline: AI messenger that builds shared apps inside your group chats
products.summaryZh: AI信使，在群聊中构建共享应用。
products.descriptionZh: 只需开口，群组或朋友所需的应用便会出现在聊天中。“我们是4个朋友在训练马拉松，帮我们建一个追踪器”就变成一个真正的应用：排行榜、连续打卡、500美元奖池，还有AI提醒谁跳过了跑步。共享软件，即时生成：原生iOS界面，整个聊天一个实时状态，零设置。完整的社交应用，而非小部件。我们从健身领域起步。一个真正的即时通讯工具。免费。
products.description: Just talk, and the apps your group or friends needs appear in the chat. "We're 4 friends training for a marathon, build us a tracker" becomes a real app: leaderboard, streaks, a $500 pot, and the AI poking whoever skips a run. Shared software, generated on the fly: native iOS UI, one live state for the whole chat, zero setup. Full-blown social apps, not widgets. We're starting with fitness. A real messenger. Free.

products.name: Catenary
products.tagline: Spatial canvas IDE for AI coding agents
products.summaryZh: AI编程智能体的空间画布IDE
products.descriptionZh: Catenary是一款空间化IDE与终端编排工具，重新定义了与AI代理的协作编程方式。告别终端标签页的混乱：• 可视化连线：连接代理以传递上下文，并运行多模型协作团队 • 全新任务岛：一键创建隔离的可视化工作区 • 一体化集成：Monaco编辑器、原生PTY终端及浏览器预览 • 完全本地优先：零遥测，全离线且私密 免费支持macOS、Windows及Linux：thecatenary.app
products.description: Catenary is a spatial IDE and terminal orchestrator that reimagines coding with AI agents. Instead of drowning in terminal tabs: • Visual Cables: Wire agents to pass context & run multi-model squads • New Task Islands: Spin up isolated visual workspaces in 1 click • All-in-One: Monaco editor, native PTY terminals & browser previews • 100% Local-First: Zero telemetry, fully offline & private Free for macOS, Windows & Linux: thecatenary.app

products.name: Pastea
products.tagline: The clipboard you can actually search
products.summaryZh: 真正可搜索的剪贴板
products.descriptionZh: Pastea是一款macOS剪贴板历史管理工具。它会保存你复制的每个链接、片段和截图，让你能在几秒内搜索、固定并重新粘贴。
products.description: Pastea is a clipboard history manager for macOS. It saves every link, snippet and screenshot you copy, so you can search, pin and paste it back in seconds.

products.name: Widgo
products.tagline: AI Sales rep for your website visitors
products.summaryZh: 您网站访客的AI销售代表
products.descriptionZh: Widgo是你网站上的AI销售代表。它会扫描你的网站，添加你提供的任何文档，并仅凭这些信息回答每位访客。它能识别公司、评估线索质量，并在你的日历上预订演示。只需一行代码。永久免费，无需信用卡。
products.description: Widgo is an AI sales rep on your website. It scans your site, adds any docs you give it, and answers every visitor from that alone. It identifies the company, scores the lead, and books the demo on your calendar. One line of code. Free forever, no card.
